description: Source code for the LatinKeyboard class, a custom keyboard implementation for an Android soft keyboard app, including key creation, visibility toggling, and IME options handling.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard
classes.description: Custom keyboard class extending Android's Keyboard, managing special keys and their visibility, IME options, and key creation.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard.LatinKey
classes.description: Inner class extending Keyboard.Key, with overridden isInside method to customize touch target area.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Creates a LatinKey from XML and stores references to special keys.

methods.name: setLanguageSwitchKeyVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the language switch key, adjusting layout accordingly.

methods.name: setImeOptions
methods.description: Sets the label and icon of the enter key based on IME options.

methods.name: setSpaceIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the space key.
